issues.classification: confirmed-frozen-source-domain/range error in surjectivity explanation with bounded prose correction
issues.finding: To explain why s must be surjective onto M minus z, the source says that otherwise some x in M minus z is not in the domain of s. But s is explicitly typed with domain M, so every such x is in its domain. Failure of surjectivity instead means that x is absent from the range of s, which is exactly why the displayed predecessor sentence would be false.
issues.action: Replaced domain by range in the Marathi prose and placed adjacent reader note OLFOL-030. MR-P030 independently supports the distinction with the native Marathi labels प्रांत, सहप्रांत and कक्षा किंवा व्याप्ती. No protected formula, macro, token, identifier or reference changed, so no structural projection is needed.

alternatives: Preserve a statement contradicted by the displayed type s from M to M minus z

issues.uncertainty: confirmed by the displayed function type, the definition of surjectivity and the immediately following predecessor sentence
issues.review_question: Does the repaired explanation now identify a missing range value as the exact obstruction to surjectivity?
